description: BD CARTO® Equipement - Piste aérodrome - Orne is a dataset listed in Geocatalogue France, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by BUREAU DE RECHERCHES GÉOLOGIQUES ET MINIÈRES. The CARTO® BD version 3.2 is the reference map database. Used on the departmental scale (1: 50 000e) at regional level (1: 250,000th), it describes all the information present on the metropolitan territory and the overseas departments. The various topics are: ADMINISTRATIVE; EQUIPMENT; FURNITURE; HYDROGRAPHY; FERRE NETWORK; ROUTIER NETWORK; TOPONYMIA. Coverage: FR. The portal shows the English title as "BD CARTO® Equipment - Airfield runway - Orne" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include Dénominations géographiques, hydrographie, Unités administratives, dénominations géographiques, Réseaux de transport, géographie. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-geocatalogue-fr.
